prompt: Stage 3-2, level 5 with 32 gold, 70 HP, 1-loss streak. You are 8 XP from level 6. Your board has a 1-star 3-cost carry and you want a 2-star. Do you level to 6 and roll the rest this round?

options.label: Level to 6 (8 gold) and roll the remaining ~24 for the carry
Level to 6, put the bench support on the board, and keep the rest of the gold
Stay 5 and roll 20 gold at level 5 odds

explanation:
Leveling and rolling in the same round only makes sense when you have enough gold to finish both jobs, and 32 is not that number. Level 6 costs 8 and puts a sixth unit on the board: that alone is a real strength jump at 3-2, where most of the lobby is also at 6 units. Rolling the remaining 24 at 20% 3-cost odds finds, on average, less than one copy of a specific 3-cost, and leaves you at 0 gold with no interest into 3-3 and 3-4. You would have spent your whole economy for a coin flip and a permanent tempo deficit.

Level, bank the 24, and you are at 30+ next round earning 3 interest. If the carry still needs its 2-star at 3-5, you roll then with 40+ gold at the same odds, or level to 7 at 4-1 and roll at 43% 3-cost odds where the copy actually shows up. Rolling at 5 is worst of all: 20 gold at 20% for a unit that a level would find later at double the rate.
principle: Level or roll in a round, not both, unless the gold covers both jobs completely.
commonMistake: Leveling "to improve the odds" and then rolling with whatever is left, which is never enough to matter.
